hints.title: Partitioning Without Leading Zeros
hints.text: A number string cannot start with digit "0", meaning any segment starting with 0 is an invalid partition component.

hints.title: Non-Decreasing Adjacent Segments
hints.text: For adjacent segments, either the current number has longer length than previous, or equal length with lexicographically greater or equal characters.

hints.title: Fast Prefix Comparison via LCP
hints.text: Precompute the longest common prefix between all pairs of string suffixes to compare equal-length segments in O(1) time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of digits string num (up to 3,500)
complexity.notes: Dynamic programming with 2D LCP array and prefix sum acceleration.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Partition backtracking has exponential branching factor.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: LCP array enables O(1) lexicographical comparisons between equal-length numeric slices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that comparing numbers of equal length reduces to LCP string comparison.
